title: Jeffrey Kripal's compilation of anomalies

tellings.quote: for research like Jeffrey Kriel's um research also. He compiles these hundreds and hundreds of of anomalies,

plain: Michael Shermer, a writer known as a skeptic, mentions the work of a scholar named Jeffrey Kripal, who he says gathers hundreds and hundreds of anomalies, meaning odd events that seem to have no ordinary explanation. Shermer brings it up while talking about research into strange experiences.
